title: The tool gateway (MCP): policy, approvals, rate limits and revocation
purpose: Show tools gated by the user and agent behind a session token, human approval for a high-risk tool, a hard no for a forbidden one, a rate limit, and revocation when the session ends.

steps.output: {"http_status": 200, "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "result": {"tools": [{"name": "metrics.query", "description": "Read a metric series from the company metrics API.", "risk": "read"}, {"name": "ticket.create", "description": "Create a ticket. Needs a human approval each time.", "risk": "high"}]}}
{"http_status": 200, "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "result": {"tools": [{"name": "metrics.query", "description": "Read a metric series from the company metrics API.", "risk": "read"}]}}

steps.display: orch mcp <signed-token-redacted> tools/call '{"name": "ticket.create", "arguments": {"title": "Latency spike on checkout"}}'
orch mcp <signed-token-redacted> tools/call '{"name": "ticket.create", "arguments": {"title": "Latency spike on checkout"}, "approval_id": "apr-6a3fb1be"}'
orch mcp <signed-token-redacted> tools/call '{"name": "ticket.create", "arguments": {"title": "Latency spike on checkout"}, "approval_id": "apr-6a3fb1be"}'
orch mcp <signed-token-redacted> tools/call '{"name": "ticket.create", "arguments": {"title": "Latency spike on checkout"}, "approval_id": "apr-6a3fb1be"}'
orch mcp <session token> tools/list   # 25 times in a row

checks.description: the data-analyst agent sees metrics.query and ticket.create; the coding agent sees only metrics.query
checks.because: The gateway filters the tool list by the agent identity inside the session token.

checks.description: a read-only tool call succeeds and reaches the metrics API with a credential the gateway obtained itself
checks.because: The tool gateway asks the broker for a 60-second credential for this session.

checks.description: a high-risk tool call is paused until a human approves it
checks.because: The tool is marked high risk in the gateway's policy.

checks.description: retrying before approval is still refused

checks.because: The approval is bound to this session, tool and arguments.

checks.description: a forbidden tool is refused outright
checks.because: No agent is in its allow list.

checks.description: the coding agent cannot call a tool that only the data-analyst may
code inside the sandbox can reach the tool gateway only through the egress gateway, using the session token
checks.because: The host is on the template's allowlist; the request carries the session token.

checks.description: a session that calls the gateway too often is rate limited (HTTP 429)
checks.because: The gateway allows 20 calls a minute per session.

checks.description: when the session ends its token stops working immediately
checks.because: The gateway asks the Manager whether the session is still active on every call.
